T3. Forward-looking reporting long-term risks (next quarters/years) [YES] — Climate crisis trajectory, persistent drought risk, multi-year barley supply strain

Synopsis:
English sparkling wine producers, led by Nyetimber, are expecting their earliest-ever harvest and a high-quality vintage year following exceptional summer heat and sunshine. Conversely, barley farmers face potentially record-low yields due to the same heat and a second consecutive drought year, threatening beer supply and raising input costs. The summer was the UK's hottest on record, with scientists attributing the heatwaves directly to climate change. Global temperatures hit 1.65°C above pre-industrial levels in August, with further warming warned. Supply chain stress in barley is compounded by similar conditions across Europe, limiting import alternatives.
